directAnswer.en: Diesel 60 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 60 lists one engine line, 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and distance 150 m / 350 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油60和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油60标出一行发动机 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、距离 150 m / 350 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection. The picture shows PetrolDirectInjectionBMW. Diesel 60 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The jump in the model numeral is not itself the output. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel 60 lists 30 MPa. Diesel 120 lists 40 MPa. Dimensions: Diesel 60 lists 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Diesel 120 lists 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Diesel 60 lists entries that Diesel 120 does not: Model line Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Pumping distance (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. Count the engine units on Diesel 120 before comparing it with the single 6105 line. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection。画面是PetrolDirectInjectionBMW。柴油60和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油机功率：柴油60标出 6105 / 144 kW；柴油120标出 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。料斗容积：柴油60标出 0.4 m³；柴油120标出 0.6 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。拿柴油120和单行 6105 比较之前，先数清柴油120写了几台发动机。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Diesel 60 lists one engine line, 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and distance 150 m / 350 m. Diesel engine power: Diesel 60 lists 6105 / 144 kW. Diesel 120 lists 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Hopper capacity: Diesel 60 lists 0.4 m³. Diesel 120 lists 0.6 m³. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. Diesel 120 lists entries that Diesel 60 does not: Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. Max. aggregate size 6 cm and below. Open /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 60 and /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油60标出一行发动机 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、距离 150 m / 350 m。理论输送量：柴油60标出 35 m³/h；柴油120标出 100 m³/h。液压泵：柴油60标出 Kawasaki double pump 100；柴油120标出 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。柴油60有、柴油120没有的行：型号行 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。看柴油60请打开 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/，看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 120 lists 290 kW as two units of 145 kW, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, distance 150 m / 500 m and aggregate 6 cm and below. Theoretical output: Diesel 60 lists 35 m³/h. Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 60 lists Kawasaki double pump 100. Diesel 120 lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 柴油120标出 290 kW（两台各 145 kW）、100 m³/h、40 MPa、距离 150 m / 500 m、骨料 6 cm 及以下。最大出口压力：柴油60标出 30 MPa；柴油120标出 40 MPa。外形尺寸：柴油60标出 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm；柴油120标出 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。柴油120有、柴油60没有的行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m；最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 list the same diesel engine power as Diesel 120?
question.zh: 柴油60和柴油120的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 lists 6105 / 144 kW. Diesel 120 lists 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油60标出 6105 / 144 kW。柴油120标出 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 120?
question.zh: 柴油60和柴油120的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 lists 35 m³/h. Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油60标出 35 m³/h。柴油120标出 100 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 60 list the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 120?

answer.en: No. Diesel 60 lists 30 MPa. Diesel 120 lists 40 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油60标出 30 MPa。柴油120标出 40 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is model line missing on Diesel 120?
question.zh: 为什么柴油120没有型号行？

answer.en: The Diesel 120 page does not list that label. Diesel 60 lists Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection.
answer.zh: 柴油120这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油60标出的是 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection画面里印出的数字。
